title: It was never fully clear where to find 'the first Reeve's confession' requirement for the Hollow Throne rite until stumbling into it naturally at Marrowgate's crypts — the Act 2 status text mentions it as a requirement well before the game surfaces where/how to get it, so a player could wander a long time looking for it.
